reason: The README describes a web conversation-view plugin that replays usage logs, aggregates token counts, and presents them as filtered stacked bar charts with totals and conversation details; visualization is its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh Web 对话视图中按时间范围和会话统计 token 用量，并通过堆叠柱状图、总计和明细进行展示。
summaries.en: Visualizes token usage in the dsh Web conversation view with time-based stacked charts, totals, and per-conversation details.

capabilities: Reads conversation usage data through the host /usage RPC channel
Aggregates token counts by time range, interval, and conversation selection
Displays stacked bar charts, totals, and per-conversation details in the web interface
